# Summary

Provide a clear and concise description of the feature you would like to see.

## Problem

Describe the problem or limitation that this feature would solve.

Example:

> I often need to manually package my mod after every build, which becomes repetitive and time-consuming.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you would like this feature to work.

Example:

> Add an option to automatically package the project after a successful build.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Use Cases

Explain how this feature would be used.

Examples:

- Creating Minecraft Bedrock add-ons.
- Managing large mod projects.
- Extension development.
- Improving productivity.

## Affected Area

Select any areas that are related to this request.

- [ ] Editor
- [ ] File Explorer
- [ ] Project System
- [ ] Git Integration
- [ ] Extension API
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build System
- [ ] Packaging
- [ ] Search
- [ ] Themes
- [ ] UI/UX
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] 3D Viewers
- [ ] Marketplace
- [ ] Other

## Target Game (Optional)

<!-- Example: Minecraft Bedrock Edition -->

## Additional Information

Provide any mockups, screenshots, examples, links, or other context that may help explain the request.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and discussions.
- [ ] This feature has not already been requested.
- [ ] I have provided enough information to explain the idea.
